representation: A five-cell array with a moving pair outline, value labels that swap in place, and a suffix strip that grows from the right after each pass.
motion: The pair outline steps one adjacent gap at a time; out-of-order labels swap at the comparison, and the suffix strip extends after each pass.
controls: state timeline with pause/continue checkpoints; no numeric slider
checkpoints: suffix grows to 5 and 8 after pass 2
misconceptionTest: The scene stops pass 1 with only 8 fixed, showing one pass did not sort the whole array. It always starts at the leftmost pair, never the middle. The final checkpoint states the early-stop rule.
accessibility: Alt text; keyboard-controllable play/pause and checkpoints; values, pair position and sorted suffix are all stated in text, not by color alone.
